info.title: PM3000 Modern Web UI REST API
info.description: Compact PM3000 API with PM3000-backed WebUI sessions, external bearer authentication, token administration, validated outlet/PDU inventory, fixed power actions, and session-only password change.

cookieAuth.name: pm3000_session
cookieAuth.description: Secure HttpOnly server-side WebUI session cookie. Browser mutations also require X-CSRF-Token.

OutletId.name: outletId
OutletId.description: Project-owned opaque identifier resolved only through the current inventory.
Base64url prefix of SHA-256 over the versioned backend row identity; collisions fail closed.

InventoryRevision.description: Opaque digest of the complete validated inventory used to detect stale action mappings.

availableActions.description: Clients may request on, off, or cycle only when independently authorized.

PduId.description: Domain-separated opaque identifier derived from the validated backend PDU row identity; collisions fail closed.

TokenRecordId.description: Opaque identifier for a token record; not a bearer credential.

TokenCreateRequest.description: Omit outlets for unrestricted outlet access. An empty array grants access to no outlets.

outlets.description: null means unrestricted; an empty array denies all outlets.
null means unrestricted; an empty array denies all outlets.

token.description: Returned exactly once. Never persisted in plaintext and never returned by list operations.

BadRequest.description: The JSON body is malformed, duplicated, or violates the closed schema.

PayloadTooLarge.description: The raw request body exceeds 1,024 bytes.

UnsupportedMediaType.description: The request is not unencoded UTF-8 application/json.

Outlet.description: One outlet resolved from the current inventory.

Unauthorized.description: A valid bearer token is required.

Forbidden.description: The authenticated principal lacks the required scope or outlet permission.

NotFound.description: The outlet identifier is not present in the current validated inventory.

BackendProtocolError.description: The backend returned missing, duplicate, ambiguous, oversized, or malformed data.

BackendUnavailable.description: The fixed read operation could not complete.

TokenCollection.description: Non-secret token metadata; plaintext tokens and digests are omitted.

TokenCreated.description: Token created; plaintext bearer credential is returned exactly once.

LastAdministrator.description: The operation would remove the final enabled administrator.

example.message: The final enabled administrator cannot be disabled or revoked.

TokenLimitReached.description: The fixed token-record limit was reached.

example.message: No additional tokens can be created.

TokenStoreUnavailable.description: The token store could not be loaded or committed safely.

InventoryChanged.description: The submitted inventory revision is stale; refresh before retrying.
